section.title: Interrogating Network Traffic With Capture and Display Filters

questions.question: What are the client and server port numbers used in first full TCP three-way handshake? (low number first then high number)
questions.hint: Look for tcp traffic or web traffic. you will notice the client using a large number and the server using a well known port for HTTP.

questions.question: Based on the traffic seen in the pcap file, who is the DNS server in this network segment? (ip address)
questions.hint: look at traffic with a source port of 53.
